fixes.explanation: An ephod, household gods, a graven image, and a molten idol, all in ONE house! The spies say, "Did you know that one of these houses has…" and then they just keep going down the list. Friend, that's not a house, that's a whole collection! Then they say, "Now think about what you should do." and leave it hanging right there. That's a hint with no hiding in it, and I love it.

Bethel? Ohhh, nice try, baker, but that name isn't in this verse. The text says they named it Dan, after their forefather Dan, who was born to Israel. The city had formerly been named Laish. Honestly, hand me a pile of name labels and no sleep, and I'd grab the wrong one too. The new name came straight off the family tree, no guessing needed.
